messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PAGER — Elevated 5xx rate on canary-2 for endpoint /v1/generate. Error rate spike to 12% over baseline 0.5%. Rollout auto-paused. Paging on-call (Maya).
Maya (eng-oncall): On it. joining bridge now -> <https://zoom.redwood/incident/1773101010|join>. Any customer-facing impact?
Jamal (support): Seeing increased error alerts from AcmeCorp and BetaApps on the hosted API. Some retries for embeddings too. Tickets: #1234, #1235. Notified account teams.
Devon (runtime): Canary-2 is model v2.3.1-quant. Canary traffic started at 1773100600, ~2% of traffic. Failure appears in the tokenization stage: lots of `InvalidKV` logs and downstream `model-inference: 502`.
Eli (mlops): Pulling canary logs. Attaching quick extract:```[17731009x] inference=canary-2 model=v2.3.1-quant request_id=abc123 status=502 reason="kv-cache-mismatch"
[17731009x] token_len=1024 seq=1 cache_key=0x7f9b... cache_miss=true
[17731009x] fallback to CPU-kernel took=45ms```
Maya (eng-oncall): Thanks. Hypothesis 1: quantized kernels in v2.3.1-quant have a regression causing KV cache corruption under certain sequence lengths. Hypothesis 2: upstream tokenizer edge-case with large prefix.
Devon (runtime): Reproducing locally with a failing prompt set. Minimal repro script:```python
# repro
resp = client.generate(model="v2.3.1-quant", prompt="<long conversation>...", max_tokens=512)
print(resp.error)
```
Repro yields `kv-cache-mismatch` after ~20 tokens for some prompts.
Eli (mlops): Canary diffs (canary vs baseline):
- kernel: optimized-attn v1.4 -> v1.5 (changed padding)
- quant profiles: per-channel reestimation
- runtime flags: `--enable-prefix-merge` enabled on canary
Notable: `--enable-prefix-merge` touched KV handling.
Sophia (product): Which customers saw errors? Jamal? Are any SLA customers impacted?
Jamal (support): AcmeCorp (hosted) saw 15 aborted requests in last 30m. BetaApps saw intermittent failures, but they have retry logic. No Dedicated customers reported.
Maya (eng-oncall): Immediate mitigation options: 1) rollback canary to v2.3.0 (safe) 2) patch kernel flag disable and resume canary 3) increase canary to gather more signals. I prefer rollback to limit customer impact. Thoughts?
Devon (runtime): Rollback safe path: deploy v2.3.0-quant to canary nodes and restart. We can do a quick config swap: remove `--enable-prefix-merge` on canary hosts. Rollback estimated 6m with 2m for health checks.
Eli (mlops): Before rollback, verify version pinning and model cache on Dedicated customers: run `rbac-check --models v2.3.1-quant` (should be empty). Also snapshot canary logs for RCA.
Maya (eng-oncall): Jamal, notify AcmeCorp we're investigating and may roll back a canary deploy; provide ETA 10m.
Jamal (support): Message drafted: "We’re investigating elevated errors affecting a small portion of traffic. We may roll back a model canary in the next 10 minutes to restore service." Sending now.
DeployBot: Starting deploy: canary pool -> v2.3.0-quant by image tag. CI checks passed.
Devon (runtime): Executing rollback command: `infra deploy --pool canary-2 --image v2.3.0-quant --graceful`
DeployBot: Canary nodes draining -> 3/3 updated -> health checks ok.
DeployBot: Rollback complete. Canary traffic resumed to v2.3.0-quant.
Maya (eng-oncall): Monitoring metrics. Error rate dropping. Current 5xx = 0.6%. Keeping oncall loop for 30m.
Eli (mlops): Ran `model-pin-check` across tenant configs: no dedicated pins to v2.3.1-quant found. Confirmed. (output: "no pinned instances")
Sophia (product): Good. Any postmortem actions?
Devon (runtime): Immediate: block `--enable-prefix-merge` from future canaries until kernel tests added. Add an integration test for long-prefix sequences to catch KV mismatch.
Eli (mlops): RCA notes to collect: timeline, canary diffs, reproducer, logs, customer impact. I'll export logs and S3 artifacts: s3://redwood-incident/1773101010/artifacts.tar.gz
Maya (eng-oncall): Assigning owners: RCA lead = Eli, Kernel follow-up = Devon, Customer comms follow-up = Jamal, QA test = Maya.
Jamal (support): I'll follow up with AcmeCorp with rollback confirmation and ETA for root-cause update.
Maya (eng-oncall): Handoff: I'll go offline in 40m; Eli will own overnight monitoring. Tagging on-call rotation. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
IncidentBot: Incident resolved (status: mitigated). Please file an incident report and link the RCA doc: <https://confluence.redwood/incidents/1773101010-rca>
Maya (eng-oncall): Filed initial postmortem stub. Eli will add detailed timeline and diffs.
Eli (mlops): Adding logs + minimal repro to the RCA doc. Will include unit test and patch PR for kernel change.
Devon (runtime): PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/1234 — disable-prefix-merge flag + test.
Sophia (product): Thanks team. We'll schedule a customer update draft once RCA is ready.
Jamal (support): Closing impacted tickets after customer confirmation.
Maya (eng-oncall): Final note: no dedicated customer disruption, hosted customers saw limited errors due to canary. Closing thread.
__notes: Document is a single-thread Slack export with messages in chronological order. All fields are strings or list of strings per agents.md.
